s: “The Imitation Game” is a 2014 film about the mathematician Alan Turing, who helped to break the German Enigma code during the Second World War.
“O Jogo da Imitação” (The Imitation Game) é um filme de 2014 sobre o matemático Alan Turing, que ajudou a quebrar o código alemão Enigma durante a Segunda Guerra Mundial.
Turing and his team worked in secret at Bletchley Park, building a machine to read enemy messages.
Turing e sua equipe trabalharam em segredo em Bletchley Park, construindo uma máquina para ler as mensagens inimigas.
Their work saved many lives; however, after the war Turing was treated unfairly.
O trabalho deles salvou muitas vidas; porém, depois da guerra Turing foi tratado injustamente.
“However” and “nevertheless” connect two contrasting ideas: “The code seemed impossible; nevertheless, they broke it.”

“In spite of” and “despite” are followed by a noun or -ing: “Despite the difficulty, they continued.”

“Even though” is stronger than “although”.
“Even though” é mais forte que “although”.
Success often comes after many failures.

s: “Mrs Dalloway” is a 1925 novel by Virginia Woolf, set in London during a single day in June.
“Mrs Dalloway” é um romance de 1925 de Virginia Woolf, ambientado em Londres durante um único dia de junho.
Clarissa Dalloway prepares a party in the evening, and while she buys flowers and meets old friends, the book follows her thoughts and memories.
Clarissa Dalloway prepara uma festa à noite, e enquanto compra flores e encontra velhos amigos, o livro acompanha os pensamentos e lembranças dela.
The party is the center of the book, and guests bring many ideas.
A festa é o centro do livro, e os convidados trazem muitas ideias.
To add an idea, use “besides”, “moreover” and “in addition”: “The party was lovely; moreover, the flowers were perfect.”
Para acrescentar uma ideia, use “besides”, “moreover” e “in addition”: “The party was lovely; moreover, the flowers were perfect.”
“Besides” is informal: “I don't want to go; besides, I'm tired.”
“Besides” é informal: “I don't want to go; besides, I'm tired.”
“In addition to” is followed by a noun or -ing: “In addition to flowers, we need music.”
“In addition to” é seguido de substantivo ou -ing: “In addition to flowers, we need music.”
Add ideas to make an argument stronger.
Acrescente ideias para tornar um argumento mais forte.

fr.title: Conheça a obra: The Little Prince
s: “The Little Prince” is a 1943 novella by the French writer Antoine de Saint-Exupéry, one of the most translated books in the world.
“O Pequeno Príncipe” é uma novela de 1943 do escritor francês Antoine de Saint-Exupéry, um dos livros mais traduzidos do mundo.
A pilot stranded in the desert meets a boy from a tiny planet who has traveled through several worlds.
Um piloto perdido no deserto conhece um menino de um planeta minúsculo que viajou por vários mundos.
In the book, the narrator says that adults are often too busy to understand what really matters.
No livro, o narrador diz que os adultos costumam estar ocupados demais para entender o que realmente importa.
“Too” + adjective shows a problem: “The planet is too small for a big tree.”
“Too” + adjetivo mostra um problema: “The planet is too small for a big tree.”
“Not… enough” shows a lack: “I don't have enough time.”
“Not… enough” mostra falta: “I don't have enough time.”
Add “to” for the action: “It's too heavy to lift.”
Acrescente “to” para a ação: “It's too heavy to lift.”
What is essential is invisible to the eye.
O essencial é invisível aos olhos.

fr.title: Conheça a obra: April Fools' Day
s: April Fools' Day, on the first of April, is the day on which people play jokes on friends and family.
O Dia da Mentira, em 1º de abril, é o dia em que as pessoas pregam peças em amigos e familiares.
Its origin is uncertain; one legend says that it began in France in 1564, when the New Year changed from April to January.
Sua origem é incerta; uma lenda diz que começou na França em 1564, quando o Ano Novo passou de abril para janeiro.
Today newspapers, brands and television shows also publish fake news on that day.
Hoje jornais, marcas e programas de TV também publicam notícias falsas nesse dia.
“Pull someone's leg” means to joke with someone: “Are you pulling my leg?”
“Pull someone's leg” significa brincar com alguém: “Are you pulling my leg?”
A “prank” is a trick, “kidding” means joking, and a “practical joke” is a physical trick.
Uma “prank” é uma peça, “kidding” significa brincar, e uma “practical joke” é uma pegadinha física.
“Just kidding!” ends the joke.
“Just kidding!” encerra a brincadeira.
Do not play a joke that can hurt anyone.
Não faça uma brincadeira que possa machucar alguém.

The show becomes popular, and they have to deal with a producer who wants to change everything.
O programa fica popular, e eles precisam lidar com um produtor que quer mudar tudo.
Their style is full of jokes, pranks and funny catchphrases.
O estilo deles é cheio de piadas, pegadinhas e bordões engraçados.
To joke with friends, use “I'm kidding”, “just joking” or “I'm pulling your leg”.
Para brincar com amigos, use “I'm kidding”, “just joking” ou “I'm pulling your leg”.
To react to a joke, say “Very funny!” or “That's hilarious!”

s: “The Man Who Knew Too Much” is a 1956 thriller directed by Alfred Hitchcock, a remake of his own 1934 film.

A family on holiday in Morocco learns about a plot to kill a politician, and the criminals kidnap their son to keep them quiet.
Uma família em férias no Marrocos descobre um plano para matar um político, e os criminosos sequestram o filho para mantê-los calados.

Review: use “who” for people, “which” for things and “whose” for possession.

Non-defining clauses add extra information with commas: “The mother, who is a singer, helps.”

Use connectors like “however” and “besides” to link ideas.

It became one of the longest-running series on American television.
Tornou-se uma das séries mais longas da televisão americana.
Detectives and lawyers use precise language, so the show is full of relative clauses and connectors.
Detetives e advogados usam linguagem precisa, então a série é cheia de orações relativas e conectores.
Review: “The man who was seen on the street is the suspect. The knife that was found is his.”
Revisão: “The man who was seen on the street is the suspect. The knife that was found is his.”
Connectors: “therefore” for a result, “however” for a contrast and “moreover” to add an idea.

Justice needs facts, not rumors.

Edmond Dantès, um jovem marinheiro, é falsamente acusado de um crime e passa catorze anos na prisão do Château d'If, onde imagina sua vingança.
After he escapes, he avoids showing his real identity while he waits for the right moment.
Depois de fugir, ele evita mostrar sua verdadeira identidade enquanto espera o momento certo.
Some verbs are followed by the -ing form: enjoy, avoid, suggest, mind, finish and imagine.

s: “Blue Peter” is a British children's television show that began in 1958 on the BBC and is the longest-running children's show in the world.
“Blue Peter” é um programa infantil britânico de televisão que estreou em 1958 na BBC e é o programa infantil mais longo do mundo.
The presenters show how to make things with simple materials and often say, “Here's one I made earlier.”
Os apresentadores mostram como fazer coisas com materiais simples e costumam dizer: “Here's one I made earlier.”
They also visit places, meet animals and ask children to take part in charity campaigns.
Eles também visitam lugares, conhecem animais e pedem às crianças que participem de campanhas de caridade.
After verbs like “enjoy”, “finish” and “practise”, use the -ing form: “I enjoy making models. I finished building the drum.”
Depois de verbos como “enjoy”, “finish” e “practise”, use a forma -ing: “I enjoy making models. I finished building the drum.”
“Keep”, “start” and “stop” also take -ing: “Keep playing!”
“Keep”, “start” e “stop” também aceitam -ing: “Keep playing!”
“Can't help” + -ing means that you cannot stop yourself: “I can't help laughing.”
“Can't help” + -ing significa que você não consegue evitar: “I can't help laughing.”
Practise a little every day.
Pratique um pouco todo dia.
